This page preserves the earlier SimplePad Q3D capacitance example and its
reported native observations. For current Q3D input authoring, use the
[body-backed Q3D lesson](../course/aedt-q3d.qmd).

## Model and source

The example uses a centered square pad surrounded by Ground on one square die.
Its authored inputs are:

| Layout or material | Input |
|---|---|
| Single die | 1000 µm × 1000 µm |
| Centered pad | 200 µm × 200 µm |
| Pad-to-Ground gap | Uniform 20 µm around the pad |
| Top metal | Aluminum, 0.2 µm thick |
| Substrate | Silicon, 500 µm thick |

The canonical public source is OrPen's pinned revision
[`51985d9`](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/51985d9507025e8241205712e866c0b804de29b9).
Its [`aedt_q3d.ipynb`](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/51985d9507025e8241205712e866c0b804de29b9/notebooks/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_q3d.ipynb)
and [editable QMD](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/51985d9507025e8241205712e866c0b804de29b9/notebooks/src/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/aedt_q3d.qmd)
define the earlier GDS-import workflow.

![The public SimplePad layout: centered pad, surrounding Ground and authored east-edge lumped-port locator.](../assets/simple-pad-layout.png){#fig-simple-pad-layout}

The locator is part of the source layout. The Q3D request below is C/G only;
it does not add an inductive branch. The Aluminum mapping to native PEC and the
open Q3D Region are part of this recorded solver model.
The model has no second die, backside metal, readout or bumps. An outer
grounded enclosure is not part of this open-Region request; the dimensions and
stack are model inputs, not measured capacitance or an accuracy claim.

## Historical Q3D request

The notebook requested these extraction and adaptive controls:

| Setting | Value |
|---|---:|
| `EXTRACTION_FREQUENCY_GHZ` | 5.0 |
| `SOLVE_AC_RL` | `False` |
| `GROUNDED_REGION_NET` | `None` |
| `MAXIMUM_PASSES` | 10 |
| `CONVERGENCE_PERCENT` | 1.0 |

Its host request used `AEDT_VERSION = "2024.2"`,
`PYAEDT_VERSION = "1.3.0"`, and
`RESOURCES = AedtResources(cores=4, ram_limit_percent=80)`. The public
notebook is the source for the original cell sequence and settings.

## Reported capacitance

The historical result report identified `PAD` as Signal and `GROUND` as
Ground. Read the `pad` row and `pad` column in the report's conductor order;
the reported entry is $C_{\mathrm{pad,pad}}$.

| Calculation | Report entry | Capacitance |
|---|---|---:|
| Q3D, pre-v3 C/G at 5 GHz | Pad row and pad column, $C_{\mathrm{pad,pad}}$ | 87.00027087746 fF |
| Palace Electrostatic comparison | Ground-referenced pad diagonal, $C_{11}$ | 95.36383731153 fF |

The native material readback recorded Silicon relative permittivity 11.9 and
Aluminum represented as PEC. Palace uses the natural electrostatic exterior;
this Q3D request used an open Region. The two results describe their respective
model and boundary choices, not a required numerical agreement.

The reference output context and full-precision rows are available in the
public [SimplePad evidence README](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/51985d9507025e8241205712e866c0b804de29b9/notebooks/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/evidence/README.md)
and [results CSV](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/51985d9507025e8241205712e866c0b804de29b9/notebooks/ComponentSimulation/SimplePad/evidence/results.csv).
The recorded SimplePad source is `24ae5a4`, with the same component and
notebook bytes as public OrPen revision `51985d9`; the SCGSim source was
`1.0.1` at `9c032e3`.

These values are observations of the documented model, not numerical targets
for a new run. The earlier GDS-import request is distinct from the current
body-backed Q3D inputs described in the [Q3D lesson](../course/aedt-q3d.qmd).
